title: Highway Rush
desc: Drive your car on a busy highway. Dodge oncoming traffic, collect coins, and survive as long as you can! Control your car using A/D keys, Arrow keys, or Mouse/Touch.
howto: A Left Arrow to turn left D Right Arrow to turn right You can also use mouse or touch
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
